newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei seen drifting at around 20,500.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei seen drifting at around 20,500.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key index is likely to drift at around 20,500 on Monday, brokers said. Sentiment is expected to be supported by a firm tone on Wall Street, but the Tokyo market lacks factors to stimulate active buying, they said.
On Friday, the 225-share Nikkei average ended down 101.01 points, or 0.49 percent, at 20,523.75. Its September futures finished 130 points lower at 20,570.
"Following the steady New York session, stocks will trade firmer (in Tokyo)," said Kenji Karikomi, deputy general manager at Daiwa Securities Co Ltd.
"But there are no factors that could spark a further rally in the market," Karikomi said.
Given the lack of buying factors, investors are likely to hunt bargains in major blue-chip issues, said a trader at a "Big Four" securities house.
On Friday, Dow industrials finished up 33 points, or 0.4 percent, at 7,688. The average had been as much as 116 points higher before late-session profit taking shaved gains.
